p2_findings: P2-1: The admitted 12/12 statement is layer-identity coverage under the fixed first/middle/last B4 component protocol. The activity/sign descriptors are real ep34, but the INT8 verification weights are directed. It is not full-token/full-FC, real-weight, same-area, power, energy, or system-speedup evidence.
verdict: PASS. The exhaustive double-sealed R10 result and consumed attempt bind the exact M2101 source, M2102 source hammer, M2103 one-shot release, and M2104 release hammer. One VCS compile produced one simv batch with 960 unique ordered workloads: 40 samples x eight previously unsupported FC2 layer identities x three fixed token roles. Independent log parsing matches the fixture, result rows, 960 reset/PASS/ledger records, 13,440 row-chunk records, 1,843,200 integer checks per axis, 115,200 commits per axis, G96/G192 continuation boundaries, and every address/commit/integer counter. All oracle mismatch and Acc24 overflow counts are zero; 960 G96 plus 960 G192 alias attacks are rejected on both axes. Ordinary scheduling consumes 80,129,099 cycles and TSBG consumes 45,381,069 cycles, a 1.7656943912x component ratio. Together with the independently admitted four G<=48 FC2 identities, this expands fixed-protocol FC2 layer-identity coverage from 4/12 to 12/12. The result uses real ep34 activity/sign descriptors and deterministic directed INT8 weights; broader claims remain prohibited.

workload_scope.weight_values: deterministic directed INT8 verification weights, not checkpoint weights

paper_language.allowed: Across eight previously unsupported G96/G192 FC2 layer identities (40 ep34 samples and three fixed token regions; 960 component workloads), continuation-aware TSBG reduced ordinary post-load RTL cycles from 80.129M to 45.381M (1.7657x), while 1.843M integer checks per axis and 115,200 commits per axis completed with zero mismatch or overflow. Combined with the prior four G<=48 identities, the fixed-protocol validation covers all 12 FC2 layer identities.
paper_language.mandatory_nearby_boundary: The activity/sign descriptors are real ep34, whereas weights are deterministic directed INT8 verification values. Results are component VCS cycles for sampled token regions, not full-token/full-FC wall time, real-weight inference, same-area performance, power, energy, or system speedup.
forbidden: full FC or full token population
full-network, end-to-end, FPS, or system speedup
multiplication with C1, C3, Prosperity, Phi, or any other factor
